context: Teacher and student dig into the Asahi Shimbun coverage of a bureaucratic scandal
purpose: Teach: 裁判官/市長/総裁/官僚/朝日新聞/朝日/決議/地位

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今朝の朝日新聞、もう読みましたか。例の官僚汚職の続報が一面に出ていましたよ。
lines.en: Did you read this morning's Asahi Shimbun yet? The follow-up on that bureaucrat corruption case was on the front page.
lines.style: Polite teacherly opening, calm but pointed curiosity, drawing the student into discussion

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 読みました。鈴木さんっていう高級官僚が、市長と一緒にダミー会社の口座を使ってたって話ですよね。
lines.en: I did. It's the story about a senior bureaucrat named Suzuki using a shell company's bank account together with the mayor, right?
lines.style: Eager university student tone, slightly informal, summarizing what he read in the article

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。朝日によると、給与とは別のお金が同社の口座に流れていたとか。資料を配布しますね。
lines.en: Exactly. According to the Asahi, money separate from his salary was flowing into that company's account. Let me hand out some materials.
lines.style: Composed lecturing rhythm, ですます polish, transitioning smoothly into teaching mode

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。あの、党の総裁まで関わってるって本当ですか。ちょっと信じられなくて。
lines.en: Thank you. Um, is it really true that even the party president is involved? I find it kind of hard to believe.
lines.style: Hesitant questioning, mild disbelief, slightly leaning forward in his chair

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 仮に総裁が直接関わっていないとしても、社会的地位を利用して不正を排除しなかった責任は重いです。
lines.en: Even if the party president wasn't directly involved, the responsibility for using his social standing and failing to root out the corruption is heavy.
lines.style: Measured analytical delivery, weighing each clause carefully with professorial gravity

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。裁判官はどう判断するんでしょうね。市長と官僚の供述、ほぼ同一だったらしいですけど。
lines.en: I see. I wonder how the judge will rule. Apparently the mayor's and the bureaucrat's statements were almost identical.
lines.style: Thoughtful follow-up, citing specific detail like an engaged seminar participant

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 鋭い指摘です。ベテラン裁判官ほど、口裏合わせを見抜きますよ。国会も近く決議を出すそうです。
lines.en: Sharp observation. The more veteran the judge, the more easily they see through coordinated stories. The Diet is also expected to pass a resolution soon.
lines.style: Approving teacher praise, then pivoting to news commentary with quiet authority

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 決議が出たら、政界への影響は余りに大きい気がします。鈴木さん、辞職じゃ済まないかもしれませんね。
lines.en: If a resolution passes, the impact on the political world feels almost too big. For Suzuki, just resigning might not be enough.
lines.style: Connecting dots aloud thoughtfully, mildly worried, voice trailing into reflection

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。だからこそ、朝日新聞のような一次資料に当たって考える習慣が、皆さんの将来の地位を支えるんです。
lines.en: Yes. That's precisely why the habit of consulting primary sources like the Asahi will support the position you all hold in the future.
lines.style: Closing pedagogical note, warm but firm, tying discussion back to student growth
